title.narrative: (MOE) Strengthening climate resilience through flood and drought management in Central 798

description.narrative: The overall objective of the project is to strengthen the climate and disaster resilience of people and communities in vulnerable regions of the Kyrgyz Republic and Uzbekistan through integrated and effective water resources management techniques. The project cost isUS$ 10million for4 years (2023-2026) funded by the Ministry of Environment, ROK.
